metadata.notes: The people on the letter list who are not in a parliamentary register: researchers, regional and municipal politicians, county governors and agency leadership. Public role addresses only; one letter per person, ever. Entries with email null are gaps or deliberate non-entries with the institutional route noted. WARNING: Sweden held municipal and regional elections on 13 September 2026; every municipal and regional politician here must be re-verified once the new assemblies take office in October 2026.

addressCheck.verified: read on the person's own staff page
addressCheck.search: found through search; confirm before activating
addressCheck.pattern: derived from the organisation's address pattern; never activate unconfirmed

fields.remit: what they decide on or study, in plain terms
fields.why: one sentence the letter can open with ('we write to you because …') and the being can choose on
fields.facts: what is on record about the recipient's own actions, each with a source and the date it was checked; the only things a letter may say they did

recipients.name: Fredrik Widemo
recipients.remit: Wildlife ecology: moose, browsing damage, co-management of ungulates; the ÄBIN target debate.
recipients.why: you study moose and browsing damage, and found no clear link between moose density and damage in Norrland — against the target the forestry industry set

recipients.name: Per Sandström
recipients.remit: Ground lichen and reindeer husbandry plans; built the RenGIS tool used by every sameby.
recipients.why: you built the tool every sameby plans with, and you have measured what happened to the ground lichen

recipients.name: Lars Östlund
recipients.remit: Forest history: a thousand years of northern forest use, and conflicts between forestry and conservation.
recipients.why: you know what this forest looked like for the thousand years before it was managed as a crop

recipients.name: Hjalmar Laudon
recipients.remit: How forestry and climate affect streams and lakes; runs the Krycklan catchment study in Västerbotten.
recipients.why: you have measured what forestry does to the water here, in the same catchment, for over twenty years

recipients.name: Gustav Hellström
recipients.remit: Fish migration and tracking, including salmon past Stornorrfors.
recipients.why: you follow the salmon through Stornorrfors and know what the ladder does and does not fix

recipients.name: Camilla Widmark
recipients.remit: Forest economics: competing land uses, and what conservation and herding cost in timber revenue.
recipients.why: you can put a number on what lichen-adapted forestry costs, which is the number this argument turns on

recipients.name: Mark Marissink
recipients.remit: Director of SLU Artdatabanken, which publishes the red list naming forestry as the top threat.
recipients.why: your red list names modern forestry as the threat to 1,744 species, which is the sentence everyone quotes and few act on

facts.text: The red list 2025 published by the Artdatabanken you lead (24 March 2026) counts 5,217 red-listed species and names modern forestry as harming 1,744 of them.

recipients.name: Jon Moen
recipients.organisation: Umeå University, Ecology and Environmental Science
recipients.remit: Land-use conflict in the north: herding against forestry, wind, mining and protected areas.
recipients.why: you study exactly the collision the council stages — herding against forestry, wind, mining and reserves

recipients.name: Tim Horstkotte
recipients.organisation: Umeå University, Ecology and Environmental Science
recipients.remit: Reindeer husbandry and forestry as one system; lodgepole pine and winter grazing.
recipients.why: you have shown what lodgepole pine and even-aged forest do to winter grazing

facts.text: Your study with colleagues (Hagenberg et al., Ecosystems 2025) found that reindeer grazing holds back mountain birch at the treeline.

recipients.name: Per-Anders Esseen
recipients.organisation: Umeå University, Ecology and Environmental Science
recipients.remit: Hair lichens: how climate and clear-cutting decide whether they survive on old trees.
recipients.why: you know which trees hair lichens need, and that clear-cutting removes them faster than they grow

recipients.name: Johan Olofsson
recipients.organisation: Umeå University, Ecology and Environmental Science
recipients.remit: Reindeer grazing and mountain vegetation, including grazing at the rising treeline.
recipients.why: you have shown that reindeer grazing protects the most sensitive mountain plants, which inverts the usual story

facts.text: Your study with colleagues (Hagenberg et al., Ecosystems 2025) found that reindeer grazing holds back mountain birch at the treeline.

recipients.name: Christer Nilsson
recipients.organisation: Umeå University, Ecology and Environmental Science
recipients.remit: River restoration; coordinated the Vindel River LIFE project that reopened 26 tributaries.
recipients.why: you coordinated the restoration that reopened 26 tributaries of this river, so you know what repair costs and what it cannot return

recipients.name: Camilla Sandström
recipients.remit: Forest and environmental policy; governance of contested land. Member of the Climate Policy Council.
recipients.why: you study how forest policy is actually made, and you sit on the Climate Policy Council

facts.text: You have been appointed to the Swedish Climate Policy Council.

recipients.name: Kristina Sehlin MacNeil
recipients.organisation: Umeå University, Várdduo — Centre for Sámi Research
recipients.remit: Extractive violence and power relations affecting Indigenous peoples; deputy director of Várdduo.
recipients.why: you named the cycle that runs from extraction through structural violence to the threats that follow a court win

recipients.name: Åsa Össbo
recipients.organisation: Umeå University, Várdduo — Centre for Sámi Research
recipients.remit: Historian of hydropower as industrial colonialism in the reindeer herding area, 1910–1968.
recipients.why: you documented hydropower in the herding area as colonialism, which is the history under every new project here

facts.text: Your dissertation Nya vatten, dunkla speglingar (2014) analysed hydropower expansion in the reindeer herding area 1910–1968 as industrial colonialism.

recipients.name: Malin Brännström
recipients.remit: Legal scholar on herding rights as property rights, and why the Forestry Act balances them away.
recipients.notes: No public address found; reported to have moved to Silvermuseet in Arjeplog. Worth finding — the single closest expert to the Sámi topic.
recipients.why: you showed that herding rights are property rights in case law but a public interest in the Forestry Act, which is why they are balanced away rather than secured

recipients.name: Peter Olofsson (S)
recipients.remit: Chair of the regional board, Region Västerbotten; said of wind power that "the network is full".
recipients.notes: Term 2023–2026. Re-verify after the new regional assembly takes office in October 2026.
recipients.why: you chair the region whose own chair said the grid here is full, while the north is still sold as the answer

recipients.name: Anders Öberg (S)
recipients.remit: Chair of the regional board, Region Norrbotten.
recipients.notes: Term 2023–2026. Re-verify after the new regional assembly takes office in October 2026.
recipients.why: you chair the region the green transition was promised to, and the one left with what it built

recipients.name: Helene Hellmark Knutsson
recipients.remit: County governor of Västerbotten (appointed to 2029): permits, nature conservation, and the state's presence in the county.
recipients.notes: No personal address published; letters reach the governor through vasterbotten@lansstyrelsen.se.
recipients.why: your county board issues the permits and manages the reserves inside the biosphere area

recipients.name: Lotta Finstorp
recipients.remit: County governor of Norrbotten; has asked the government for heliskiing rules since 2023.
recipients.notes: No personal address published; letters reach the governor through norrbotten@lansstyrelsen.se.
recipients.why: you have asked the government for heliskiing rules since 2023 and not been given them

recipients.name: Hans Lindberg (S)
recipients.remit: Chair of the municipal executive board, Umeå.
recipients.notes: Term to October 2026. Municipal elections were held on 13 September 2026 — re-verify before the first letter.
recipients.why: the river reaches the sea in your municipality, past the turbine

recipients.name: Lorents Burman (S)
recipients.remit: Chair of the municipal executive board, Skellefteå.
recipients.why: you cut your wind plan from 23 areas to 2, and the plant that failed and was sold stands in your municipality

recipients.name: Roland Sjögren
recipients.remit: Chair of the municipal executive board, Lycksele.
recipients.why: you govern the inland forest where felling, herding and tourism meet on the same ground

recipients.name: Pia Sjöberg (S)
recipients.remit: Chair of the municipal executive board, Sorsele.
recipients.why: you govern a Sámi administrative municipality on the upper Vindelälven

recipients.name: Ulrik Dahlgren
recipients.remit: Chair of the municipal executive board, Storuman: Juktan pumped storage and the Blaiken clean-up.
recipients.why: the Juktan application and the Blaiken clean-up are both yours, one promising power and one still being paid for

recipients.name: Mathias Haglund (S)
recipients.remit: Chair of the municipal executive board, Vindeln.
recipients.notes: Address not published; the municipality's pattern is fornamn.efternamn@vindeln.se. Confirm before activating.
recipients.why: the middle Vindelälven runs through your municipality, and wind power needs your consent

recipients.name: Isak Utsi (S)
recipients.remit: Chair of the municipal executive board, Arjeplog: four uranium exploration permits granted in 2026.
recipients.notes: No address published; kommun@arjeplog.se reaches the board.
recipients.why: four uranium exploration permits were granted in your municipality in 2026, where the 1981 protest stopped the last one

recipients.name: Béatrice Öman (S)
recipients.remit: Chair of the municipal executive board, Boden (since 13 October 2025): the steel plant and the debt.
recipients.notes: No address published; kommunen@boden.se reaches the board. Re-verify after the autumn 2026 term change.
recipients.why: you govern the town that borrowed more than a billion kronor ahead of a plant with no start date, and where this council meets

recipients.name: Staffan Norin
recipients.remit: Director-General of Skogsstyrelsen since 1 March 2026, and based in Umeå.
recipients.notes: Agencies do not publish their director-general's address. A letter to skogsstyrelsen@skogsstyrelsen.se addressed to the Director-General is registered and reaches them — which is why the other agency heads are not listed separately.
recipients.why: you took over the agency in March 2026 and administer a law that cuts the review window to three weeks in January
